parsed.notes:
'Dein Profil' is a requirements heading, so items default to required. Skills that appear only under 'Deine Aufgaben' are not labeled unless the profile repeats them.
'idealerweise' (ideally) is an inline marker: OpenShift, PostgreSQL and MongoDB are nice_to_have.
OpenShift is the only managed-Kubernetes example with a taxonomy id. STACKIT SKE, AKS, EKS and GKE are unmapped, so no group can be formed (a group needs at least two mapped skills).
Terraform, Argo CD and Helm are grouped as 'z. B. X, Y, Z oder W' alternatives. They are examples spanning IaC and GitOps rather than a single ask, so the grouping is flagged uncertain. Kustomize is unmapped.
'Kenntnisse in Cloud-Infrastrukturen' is mapped to cloud via the 'cloud infrastructure' alias.
'Kubernetes- und Cloud-Security' is mapped to cybersecurity. There is no exact alias, so this is flagged uncertain.
Least-Privilege and IAM/RBAC both map to access-control and are collapsed into one criterion.
Monitoring/Logging/Alerting is mapped to observability.
The Secrets Management raw_text includes 'Network Policies,' to point at the profile mention rather than the responsibilities mention.
Degree: the posting accepts a vocational IT-Ausbildung as an alternative and adds 'oder vergleichbar', so degree_or_equivalent is true. Flagged uncertain because 'vergleichbar' may only widen the field rather than accept experience in place of the degree.
Seniority: 'Fundierte' and 'Umfangreiche' are depth wording, not level signals, so seniority is none.
